title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Business Service - Consignment
description: A business transaction of a shipper as customer with a service provider (e.g. a carrier or forwarder) for the transport of goods or containers from one location to another, where all goods and containers have to arrive in a given time period (businessService:Consignment, FEDeRATED Business Service ontology, subclass of BusinessTransaction), extended by the SIMPLE project with delivery time windows, a booking list and arrival/departure location relationships.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Consignment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

createdBy.description: Property. businessService:createdBy (inherited from BusinessTransaction). Creator of the business transaction.

hasSequenceNumber.description: Property. businessService:hasSequenceNumber (inherited from BusinessTransaction). The business transaction's sequence number. Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment specifically.

transportPlanIssuanceTime.description: Property. businessService:transportPlanIssuanceTime (inherited from BusinessTransaction). Date that the transport plan is issued.

dischargePortOfCall.description: Property. simple-bs:dischargePortOfCall (SIMPLE extension, domain BusinessTransaction, inherited via Consignment rdfs:subClassOf BusinessTransaction). Port attended within a voyage to discharge the cargo; a technical term used in official shipping documents.

loadPortOfCall.description: Property. simple-bs:loadPortOfCall (SIMPLE extension, domain BusinessTransaction, inherited via Consignment rdfs:subClassOf BusinessTransaction). Port attended within a voyage to load the cargo.

consignmentCreationTime.description: Property. businessService:consignmentCreationTime. Time that the Consignment is created.

consignmentUpdateTime.description: Property. businessService:consignmentUpdateTime. Time that the Consignment is updated.

numberofPackages.description: Property. DigitalTwin:numberofPackages. Number of packages in this consignment. Name preserved verbatim from the source ontology (not renamed to 'numberOfPackages'). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

bookingList.description: Property. simple-bs:bookingList (SIMPLE extension). List of numbers associated to a Consignment, relevant in the maritime leg of a business transaction; normally reflected in a booking confirmation.

earliestDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:earliestDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Earliest time at which this consignment can be delivered to the final destination.

expectedDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:expectedDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Expected delivery time for this consignment.

latestDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:latestDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Latest time by which this consignment should be delivered to the final destination.

hasService.description: Relationship. businessService:hasService (inherited from BusinessTransaction). The logistics service this business transaction is part of. Range: LogisticsService (this candidate's TransportService or CargoHandlingService, or an out-of-scope LogisticsService subtype).

involvedActor.description: Relationship. businessService:involvedActor (inherited from BusinessTransaction). Legal persons (enterprises, organizations, natural persons) playing a role in this consignment. Range: LegalPerson (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

involvedEvent.description: Relationship. businessService:involvedEvent (inherited from BusinessTransaction). Logistics events involved with this consignment. Range: Event (FEDeRATED Event module, out of scope of this candidate).

partOfTransportMovementType.description: Relationship. businessService:partOfTransportMovementType (inherited from BusinessTransaction). Whether this consignment is part of main-, on- or pre-carriage. Range: Classifications:TransportMovementType (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

goodsTypeCode.description: Relationship. DigitalTwin:goodsTypeCode. Type code(s) of the goods in this consignment. Range: Classifications:GoodsTypeCode (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

usedGoods.description: Relationship. businessService:usedGoods. Goods that are part of this consignment. Range: DigitalTwin:Goods (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

usedPackage.description: Relationship. businessService:usedPackage. Packages that are part of this consignment. Range: DigitalTwin:Package (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

usedTransportEquipment.description: Relationship. businessService:usedTransportEquipment. Transport equipment used for this consignment. Range: DigitalTwin:Equipment (out of scope of this candidate). Required: base ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Consignment.

hasArrivalLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasArrivalLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Arrival location of this consignment. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject, per the SIMPLE ontology's own asserted range (out of scope of this candidate).

hasDepartureLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasDepartureLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Departure location of this consignment. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject (out of scope of this candidate).
